objects.name: Form
objects.description: A completed form with its frozen field definitions and typed answers.

icon.description: A compact form sheet with three input lines and one checked field.

properties.name: notes
properties.description: Optional additional information the person wants to communicate. It may be empty.

required.description: Whether an answer must be present.

label.description: Human-readable option label frozen with the form.

options.description: Allowed choices. Present only for enum and multi_enum.

help_info_text.description: Optional guidance displayed by the native form.

fields.description: Ordered frozen field definitions used to render and validate this submission.

key.description: Key of a field declared by form_shape.fields.

value.description: Typed answer validated against the matching frozen field definition.

notes.description: Optional additional information the person wants to communicate. It may be empty.

validation_rules: The content is standalone and does not require a Pocket Genes service or another registered object.
Only the declared properties are allowed; platform identity, ownership, revision, provenance and storage metadata stay outside the content.
Required strings must contain at least one non-whitespace character.
notes is optional, may be empty, and must not be populated with discarded technical metadata.
Definition and answer keys must each be unique.
Every answer key must be declared by the frozen form shape and match its declared type.
enum and multi_enum require nonempty options; all other field types must omit options.
Optional unanswered fields may be omitted and fields may be empty when no required answer exists.
use_cases: Symptom intake without existing pieces.
Informed consent request without existing pieces.
Language and layout selection accompanying final report inputs.
